Name: Dwarvish Translation Guide is a Book
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
This mod turns the Dwarvish Translation Guide in a book! Take it in your inventory, trash it, read it, or buy a new one at the bookseller!

Introduces a new item with the same name, description and sprite, but a different item category: book. If you do not have the power yet, you get this book instead of the 'crafting' item when donating all scrolls. You can take it from the museum rewards into your inventory, you can read it to grant you the power, or you can trash it. After donating all scrolls you also can start buying the book at the bookseller, in case you trashed it or want to gain experience in all skills.

[size=3][b]Options[/b][/size]
[size=2]There are three sprite options to choose from, see pictures:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][size=2]large, same look and size as most books[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]small, same look and size as the price catalogue and animal catalogue[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=2][size=2]vanilla, if you don't want to use the new sprites[/size][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Thanks to BETAS, reading the book will instantly grant you the power!

Does not change the original item, or the power.

Does change the museum rewards.

Can be installed at any point, but will have no effect if you already have the power, or the original Dwarvish Translation Guide (the 'crafting' item) in the museum rewards ready to be consumed. So it is safe to keep it installed next to your older saves. Those saves will not have the book sold at the bookseller.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
I am not sure this mod in itself will see much changes. Maybe more item properties, like gifting to villagers, selling in the shipping bin, trading it at the bookseller for different items?

This mod will be a requirement for a future mod I am working on: Secret of the Three Pillars ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/5771]teaser 1[/url]﻿) ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/6432]teaser 2[/url]). But it functions perfectly as a stand-alone!

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS [/url]from Spiderbuttons!
